###############################################################################
# Power Without War: UI lane slot helpers (generated by tools/pww_ui_gen.py).
# Called only from pww_ui_effects.txt. Inputs are the pww_ui_t_* temps that
# pww_ui_load_sit / pww_ui_load_ag fill; the slot index comes from
# pww_ui_ns (situations), pww_ui_lslot (ledger) or pww_ui_nk (dossier).
###############################################################################

pww_ui_store_sit_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 0 } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_id = pww_ui_t_id }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_seat = pww_ui_t_seat }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_tmpl = pww_ui_t_tmpl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_res = pww_ui_t_res }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_days = pww_ui_t_days }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_phase = pww_ui_t_phase }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_tstate = pww_ui_t_tstate }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_pledge = pww_ui_t_pledge }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_dev = pww_ui_t_dev }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_hasp = pww_ui_t_hasp }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_cl = pww_ui_t_cl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_ho = pww_ui_t_ho }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_pa = pww_ui_t_pa }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_date = pww_ui_t_date }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s0_kind = pww_ui_t_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 1 } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_id = pww_ui_t_id }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_seat = pww_ui_t_seat }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_tmpl = pww_ui_t_tmpl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_res = pww_ui_t_res }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_days = pww_ui_t_days }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_phase = pww_ui_t_phase }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_tstate = pww_ui_t_tstate }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_pledge = pww_ui_t_pledge }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_dev = pww_ui_t_dev }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_hasp = pww_ui_t_hasp }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_cl = pww_ui_t_cl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_ho = pww_ui_t_ho }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_pa = pww_ui_t_pa }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_date = pww_ui_t_date }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s1_kind = pww_ui_t_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 2 } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_id = pww_ui_t_id }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_seat = pww_ui_t_seat }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_tmpl = pww_ui_t_tmpl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_res = pww_ui_t_res }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_days = pww_ui_t_days }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_phase = pww_ui_t_phase }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_tstate = pww_ui_t_tstate }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_pledge = pww_ui_t_pledge }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_dev = pww_ui_t_dev }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_hasp = pww_ui_t_hasp }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_cl = pww_ui_t_cl }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_ho = pww_ui_t_ho }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_pa = pww_ui_t_pa }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_date = pww_ui_t_date }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s2_kind = pww_ui_t_kind }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_ns = 3 } }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s3_id = pww_ui_t_id }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s3_seat = pww_ui_t_seat }
		set_variable = { pww_ui_s3_tmpl = pww_ui_t_tmpl }

}

pww_ui_clear_ag_slots = {
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l0_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l1_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l2_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l3_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l4_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { pww_ui_l5_on = 0 }
}

# Viewer scope: copy the loaded coercion readout into temps.
pww_ui_readout_to_temps = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_dem = pww_coer_rd_dem }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_state = pww_coer_rd_state }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_prev = pww_coer_rd_prev }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_cause = pww_coer_rd_cause }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_cause_side = pww_coer_rd_cause_side }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_for0 = pww_coer_rd_for0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_for1 = pww_coer_rd_for1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_for2 = pww_coer_rd_for2 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_for3 = pww_coer_rd_for3 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_hold0 = pww_coer_rd_hold0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_hold1 = pww_coer_rd_hold1 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_hold2 = pww_coer_rd_hold2 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_hold3 = pww_coer_rd_hold3 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_nfor = pww_coer_rd_nfor }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_nhold = pww_coer_rd_nhold }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_reveal = pww_coer_rd_reveal }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_warn = pww_coer_rd_warn }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_intel = pww_coer_rd_intel }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_cred_band = pww_coer_rd_cred_band }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_alarm_band = pww_coer_rd_alarm_band }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_patron = pww_patron }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_c_rival = pww_rival }
}

# Target scope: write the temps where the coercion scripted loc reads them
# (unprefixed, on THIS = the dossier target; the loc lines use FROM = target).
pww_ui_readout_from_temps = {
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_dem = pww_ui_c_dem }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_state = pww_ui_c_state }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_prev = pww_ui_c_prev }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_cause = pww_ui_c_cause }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_cause_side = pww_ui_c_cause_side }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_for0 = pww_ui_c_for0 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_for1 = pww_ui_c_for1 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_for2 = pww_ui_c_for2 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_for3 = pww_ui_c_for3 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_hold0 = pww_ui_c_hold0 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_hold1 = pww_ui_c_hold1 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_hold2 = pww_ui_c_hold2 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_hold3 = pww_ui_c_hold3 }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_nfor = pww_ui_c_nfor }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_nhold = pww_ui_c_nhold }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_reveal = pww_ui_c_reveal }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_warn = pww_ui_c_warn }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_intel = pww_ui_c_intel }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_cred_band = pww_ui_c_cred_band }
	set_variable = { pww_coer_rd_alarm_band = pww_ui_c_alarm_band }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_c_patron > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_patron = pww_ui_c_patron } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { pww_ui_c_rival > 0 } } set_variable = { pww_rival = pww_ui_c_rival } }
}

# Global market report (any scope). Bands from the two most desperate buyers
# of each resource (core desperation); causes from those buyers and from live
# Situations over the resource.
pww_ui_market_report = {
	set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_date = global.date }
	set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_day = global.num_days }
	set_global_flag = pww_ui_mkt_ready
	# oil
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_m1 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_m2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_b1_oil = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_b2_oil = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_variable = pww_desp_oil }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_oil > pww_ui_m1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_m2 = pww_ui_m1 }
			set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_b2_oil = global.pww_ui_mkt_b1_oil }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_m1 = pww_desp_oil }
			set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_b1_oil = THIS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pww_desp_oil > pww_ui_m2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_m2 = pww_desp_oil }
			set_variable = { global.pww_ui_mkt_b2_oil = THIS }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ms = pww_ui_m1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { pww_ui_ms = 0.6 }

# Country scope: temps pww_ui_imp (units imported) and pww_ui_con (units
# consumed) summed over the seven resources.
pww_ui_import_sums = {
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@oil }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@oil }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@aluminium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@rubber }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@tungsten }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@steel }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@chromium }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_imp = resource_imported@coal }
	add_to_temp_variable = { pww_ui_con = resource_consumed@coal }
}
